entities.summary: Marcelo "Marcelinho" Magalhães Machado is a former Brazilian professional basketball player. At a height of 2.01 m tall, and a weight of 95 kg (209 lb), he played at the shooting guard and small forward positions, with small forward being his main position. He spent most of his career playing with Flamengo in Brazil's top-tier level NBB league, and he was also a long-time member of the senior men's Brazilian national basketball team.
